vulnerabilities.description: Plaintext data storage without encryption. Session and memory data stored in JSON files without encryption could expose sensitive information if the .claude-flow directory is compromised.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information

vulnerabilities.description: Plaintext session data storage. Session context and metrics stored unencrypted in .claude-flow/sessions/current.json
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information

vulnerabilities.description: Insufficient input validation on keys. While regex pattern /^[a-z0-9_]+$/i is present, it only validates format but not prevents reserved key names or namespace collisions
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

vulnerabilities.description: Potential information disclosure via git commands. Executing git commands to retrieve user info (git config user.name) could expose user identity
Missing file permission validation. Directory created with default umask (recursive: true) may have overly permissive permissions
No rate limiting on memory operations. Multiple rapid calls could cause performance degradation or denial of service on file system
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

vulnerabilities.description: Temporary file cleanup in finally block could fail silently. Error handling for unlinkSync doesn't log or alert on cleanup failure

summary: The codebase has LOW overall risk with a few MEDIUM severity issues related to unencrypted data storage. No critical vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, or XSS vulnerabilities detected.
positive_findings: ✓ No hardcoded API keys, passwords, or credentials found
✓ No SQL injection vulnerabilities (calculator-focused app with no direct DB queries in provided code)
✓ No XSS vulnerabilities in React components (proper JSX escaping)
✓ Environment variables properly prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC_ for frontend exposure
✓ Command injection properly mitigated using spawnSync (no shell interpretation)
✓ No CSRF vulnerabilities apparent in Next.js implementation
✓ Proper use of randomBytes for temporary file naming in github-safe.js
✓ Input validation present on key names in memory.js and session.js

recommendations.description: Encrypt sensitive data in memory.js and session.js using crypto module
recommendations.implementation: Use crypto.createCipheriv() for AES-256-GCM encryption of session/memory data before writing to disk

recommendations.description: Set restrictive file permissions on .claude-flow directories
recommendations.implementation: Create directories with mode 0o700 (rwx------) to restrict access to owner only

recommendations.description: Strengthen key validation with reserved word checking
Implement rate limiting on memory/session operations
recommendations.implementation: Add debouncing or throttling to prevent rapid sequential calls

recommendations.description: Improve temporary file cleanup with better error handling
recommendations.implementation: Log cleanup errors and implement retry logic with exponential backoff

recommendations.description: Add security audit logging for sensitive operations
recommendations.implementation: Log all memory/session read/write operations with timestamp and operation type
